diagnoses.description: Date disambiguation failure: OCR text contains multiple plausible date-like strings, including an OCR-corrupted label line (“Salesperson: Data: 09/08/2018”) and the true header “Date: 09/03/2018”. A naive “first match” or “most confident-looking match” selector can pick the wrong one, especially when DATE→DATA corruption occurs.
diagnoses.evidence: Allowed feedback: 034.jpg date_correct=false while amount_correct=true. In the historical OCR output (m0014), the extracted text includes “Salesperson: Data: 09/08/2018”. Visual inspection of 034.jpg shows a clear header block with “Date: 09/03/2018” near receipt metadata. This indicates the pipeline likely over-weighted the OCR-mutated label line or failed to prioritize the primary header Date field.

locations.section: Field Extraction Heuristics (Receipts) / Date extraction (reduce false positives)

diagnoses.description: Total selection failure due to OCR digit-flip outlier on a total-like line: the receipt’s internal anchors (Subtotal/Total incl/Payment) are consistent, but one OCR line produced an implausible 702.00 and the pipeline selected it.
diagnoses.evidence: Allowed feedback: 074.jpg amount_correct=false while date_correct=true; prediction total_amount="702.00". The OCR output (m0017) shows “Subtotal : 102.00”, “Payment : 102.00”, but also “Total inel. of GBT 702.00” and “Toial Amt Rounded ... yo2.00”. The image itself shows totals around 102.00. This is a classic 1→7 digit flip where anchor-consistency should override keyword priority or ‘last total wins’.

locations.section: Field Extraction Heuristics (Receipts) / Total amount extraction (avoid subtotals/cash/change)
Field Extraction Heuristics (Receipts) / Anchor-driven outlier rejection (critical for OCR digit flips like 102.00→702.00)

diagnoses.description: Rounding precedence failure: the extractor selected the pre-rounding inclusive total instead of the final payable TOTAL after a rounding adjustment, causing an exact-match miss (often by 0.01).
diagnoses.evidence: Allowed feedback: 077.jpg amount_correct=false while date_correct=true; prediction total_amount="23.26". Visual inspection of 077.jpg shows “Total (Inclusive of GST): 23.26”, “Rounding Adj: -0.01”, then bold “TOTAL: 23.25”. The OCR output (m0017) includes the rounding line but the pipeline still chose the inclusive total, implying the rounding precedence rule was not enforced mechanically.

locations.section: Field Extraction Heuristics (Receipts) / Rounding handling (common exact-match failure) — HARD RULE

diagnoses.description: Schema/normalization failure: total_amount was emitted as an empty string instead of null, violating the task’s strict output requirements. This is a post-processing guard failure independent of OCR quality.
diagnoses.evidence: Allowed feedback: 078.jpg amount_correct=false; predictions table shows total_amount="" (empty string). Task spec requires null when extraction fails and exactly two decimals when it succeeds. The OCR output (m0017) actually contains total-like lines (“a Total — 92:80”, “GrandTota. ... 92.80”), so even if selection failed, the output should have been null rather than empty string.

quality_impact.rationale: The current candidate image-ocr skill already encodes the key fixes implied by the historical failures (label-tolerant header-date ranking; total keyword priority with exclusions; rounding precedence as a hard rule; anchor-driven outlier rejection; decimal-separator normalization; and an explicit empty-string→null guard). Additional edits risk redundancy or overfitting; the remaining gap is more likely implementation adherence than missing guidance.

trigger_precision.rationale: Candidate guidance is narrowly scoped to receipt OCR and triggers only under specific conditions (e.g., split-line fallback only when keyword line has no digits; anchor override only when multiple anchors agree; header-line exclusion only for clear table headers). No further broadening is needed.

instruction_compliance.rationale: Diagnoses rely only on permitted evidence (field-level correctness feedback, predictions, and provided OCR outputs/images) and do not reference oracle values. No tool execution is requested. No unnecessary skill files are modified.

solution_path_coverage.rationale: Covers all observed failure classes: wrong date among multiple candidates (034), wrong total due to OCR digit flip/outlier (074), wrong total due to rounding precedence (077), and schema/normalization failure (078).

skillaxe_evaluation.overall_rationale: Given the packet’s evidence and the already-updated candidate image-ocr skill, the most effective next step is ensuring downstream implementations actually apply the documented rules (especially: header-date preference, anchor-consistency override, rounding precedence, and final schema guard). The skill text itself does not appear to be the limiting factor in this iteration.
